10% comission on 1st purchase 

2.5% lifetime purchase comission for 10 years.

(Includes one off purchases as well as subscription customers. Average order value is £124.)

• Brand introduction: Log Club

Supplier of Kiln Dried UK Woodsure Certified Firewood Logs for sale, founded in January 2023.

FSC Logs supplied from UK forests, grown and harvested to our exacting standards; dried and prepared in our unique Eco Kilns, using 100% self generated renewable energy. Delivered both locally (free delivery) and nationally (cost of shipping) in the UK. We believe in ecological quality and consistency, providing firewood that meets all regulatory standards every time, regardless of the time of year.

5 star reviews - 100% of customers to date.

• Product description:

Bulk bags or pallets of net bags of kiln dried softwood logs.

Great for many uses, but especially ideal for the most stringent Euro2022 low emission log burning stoves.


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

All logs are local (Wales, UK) so low carbon footprint on logisitics (i.e. a lot of UK firewood is shipped from Eastern Europe or North America)

It is essential for wood to be dried below 20% moisture in the UK to meet Defra standards. Our wood is dried lower than 10%.

Unlike the competition we use a fraction of the energy they do to dry the wood (less than 10%, usually 5%)

We only use self generated 100% renewable energy to dry the wood (Solar, Wind, Green gas and Biomass). Green gas and biomass is waste product from our own wood.

This is fantastic wood for the customer and the best wood in the UK for the climate impact it has (both local environment and global warming) - 95% less CO2 than gas - 80% less particulates than hardwood.


• Payment terms:

Monthly into registered Bank Account (commisions)


• Other information: 

Subscriptions available for assured supply and significant customer discounts up to 20%.
